name: InBiot MCP Server
description: Provides real-time air quality monitoring and historical data analysis for InBiot MICA sensors with integrated WELL Building Standard compliance checks. It allows users to compare indoor conditions with outdoor weather and receive actionable health recommendations based on global air quality standards.
